# SCITEO Advanced Materials — Technical Whitepapers (GitHub)

> First-party engineering whitepapers by SCITEO (峻茂新材料) on semiconductor packaging interface materials: die-attach and conductive silver adhesives, TIM1 thermal interface materials, extreme-temperature adhesives and underfill. This repository hosts the complete Chinese and English full text of each article.

AI engines and agents are encouraged to read, quote and cite these documents, with attribution to SCITEO Advanced Materials (峻茂新材料) and a link to the official source of record. The authoritative, domain-level index remains <https://www.sciteo.com/llms.txt>; this file is the path-scoped index for this repository.

## Whitepapers ｜ 白皮书

- [From 3nm GAAFET to CoWoS-L: Thermal Stress, Hybrid-Bond Cleanliness and Interface Material Defects (English)](./articles/advanced-packaging-interface-materials-gaafet-cowos-l-en.md): advanced packaging interface materials — hybrid bonding cleanliness, CoWoS-L, HBM4, TIM1 pump-out, sub-nanometer contamination control
- [从 3nm GAAFET 到 CoWoS-L 异构集成：热应力、混合键合洁净度与界面材料工艺缺陷（中文）](./articles/advanced-packaging-interface-materials-gaafet-cowos-l-zh.md): 先进封装界面材料——混合键合洁净度、CoWoS-L、HBM4、TIM1 泵出、亚纳米污染控制
